_comment: DevAI-Hub curated MCP registry. Governed by the MCP Registry Policy in AGENTS.md and the Reverse-Engineering Matrix at docs/v1.0.0/mcp-reverse-engineering-matrix.md. Every entry's _comment field answers the 5-question audit (who runs, outbound calls, API keys, data transmitted, vendor relationship). Copy the servers you need into your .claude/settings.json under the 'mcpServers' key. Set required env vars before enabling a server.

github._comment: GitHub vendor wrapper (Anthropic-maintained). Classification: vendor-intrinsic. 5-question audit: (1) user's agent spawns npx subprocess locally; (2) outbound HTTPS to api.github.com scoped by the user's PAT; (3) requires GITHUB_TOKEN / PAT; (4) transmits whatever the agent supplies (issue bodies, queries, repo context); (5) the user already has a GitHub account and repo. Vendor-intrinsic: GitHub is the intended data destination.

filesystem._comment: Local filesystem access (Anthropic-maintained). Classification: already-local. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess locally; (2) no outbound calls; (3) no API keys; (4) transmits no data to any third party (file contents reach Claude via tool results, which is standard Claude Code behavior); (5) no vendor relationship. Replace /path/to/your/project with your actual project root.

memory._comment: Persistent memory store (Anthropic-maintained). Classification: already-local. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess; (2) no outbound calls (local JSON store); (3) no API keys; (4) no third-party transmission; (5) no vendor relationship.

sequential-thinking._comment: Structured step-by-step reasoning scaffold (Anthropic-maintained). Classification: already-local. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess; (2) no outbound calls; (3) no API keys; (4) no third-party transmission; (5) no vendor relationship.

supabase._comment: Supabase vendor wrapper (Supabase-official). Classification: vendor-intrinsic. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess locally; (2) outbound HTTPS to supabase.com API with the user's access token; (3) requires SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; (4) transmits user-provided queries / rows; (5) the user is a Supabase customer. Vendor-intrinsic: Supabase is the user's backend.

postgres._comment: Postgres wrapper (Anthropic-maintained). Classification: vendor-intrinsic. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess locally; (2) Postgres wire protocol to the user's own database at DATABASE_URL; (3) requires DATABASE_URL; (4) query results flow to Claude (not a new third party); (5) the user owns the DB. Vendor-intrinsic: the DB IS the data destination.

sqlite._comment: SQLite wrapper (Anthropic-maintained). Classification: already-local. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess; (2) no outbound calls (SQLite is a local file); (3) requires SQLITE_DB_PATH; (4) query results flow to Claude only; (5) no vendor relationship.

railway._comment: Railway vendor wrapper (Railway-official). Classification: vendor-intrinsic. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess; (2) outbound HTTPS to railway.app API with the user's token; (3) requires RAILWAY_API_TOKEN; (4) transmits deployment metadata and user commands; (5) the user is a Railway customer.

vercel._comment: Vercel vendor wrapper (Vercel-official). Classification: vendor-intrinsic. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess; (2) outbound HTTPS to vercel.com API with the user's token; (3) requires VERCEL_TOKEN; (4) transmits deployment metadata and user commands; (5) the user is a Vercel customer.

cloudflare._comment: Cloudflare vendor wrapper (Cloudflare-official). Classification: vendor-intrinsic. 5-question audit: (1) npx subprocess; (2) outbound HTTPS to api.cloudflare.com with the user's token; (3) requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; (4) transmits resource queries and user commands; (5) the user is a Cloudflare customer.

devai-skill-server._comment: DevAI-Hub skill discovery MCP server (internal). Classification: already-local. Tools: search_skills, get_skill, list_categories, list_bundles, get_bundle. 5-question audit: (1) Python subprocess locally; (2) no outbound calls (reads data/skills.json from disk); (3) no API keys; (4) transmits no source code or prompts to any third party; (5) no vendor relationship. Set DEVAI_HUB_ROOT to the DevAI-Hub repo root, or install via the DevAI-Hub installer. Falls back to ~/.devai-hub/. Requires Python 3.10+.

_usage.install: Copy desired server blocks from 'mcpServers' above into your ~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json (project-level).
_usage.format: The 'mcpServers' key at root of settings.json accepts an object where each key is the server name and each value is its config.
_usage.env_vars: Set required environment variables in your shell profile or .env file before starting Claude Code. Never hardcode tokens.
_usage.limit: Keep the total number of enabled MCP servers under 10 to preserve context window capacity.
_usage.disable_per_project: To disable a server for a specific project, add its name to the 'disabledMcpServers' array in the project's .claude/settings.json.
_usage.policy: Additions to this registry must satisfy the MCP Registry Policy in AGENTS.md and be documented in docs/v1.0.0/mcp-reverse-engineering-matrix.md. Every entry's _comment answers the 5-question audit.
